One name, two parts

Work at the counter. Sell beyond it.

JB One is a mobile app for the jewellery counter and a web app for your shop's online catalogue. Use one or both. {{trial.text}}

JB One App · Android

Tags, estimates and rates on your phone

Staff sign in with a username and password. The shop owner decides which staff see which module.

  • Design and bulk-print jewellery tags to a thermal printer
  • Gold and silver customer estimates with wastage, making, hallmark and GST
  • Live gold and silver rates with history, and a rate ticker on the home screen
  • Bills in English or Tamil, shared as image, text, PDF or WhatsApp
See the app
JB One Web · Catalogue & admin

Your shop's own online catalogue

Your shop gets its own web address (or your own domain) showing your categories and products, plus an admin back office to manage them. Modules such as the live rate, wishlist, ring size and online purchase are switched on shop by shop.

  • Categories and products with photos, weight, purity and optional price
  • Customers enquire on WhatsApp, call, or open directions once you add your shop's number and address
  • Optional live gold rate strip and a shareable rate card with your logo
  • Installable on a phone like an app, with your logo and colours
See the catalogue
JB One App

Everything a jewellery counter does, in one app

From the tag on a chain to the bill in a customer's hand.

01 · PRINT LABEL

Design once, print a hundred

Fill a batch grid with your items, or import a spreadsheet, and print every tag with one tap.

  • Purity, description, weight, HUID and gross weight columns, with copies per row
  • Import from CSV or Excel and map the columns
  • Preview each tag to scale before printing
  • Works with Bluetooth LE, USB and Wi-Fi/LAN thermal printers
02 · CALCULATOR

An estimate the customer can read

Pick gold or silver and the purity, enter the weight, and the rate fills in from today's 22K gold or silver rate, and you can edit it.

  • Wastage in percent or grams, hallmark, making charge, GST and advance
  • Total, tax and balance worked out line by line
  • Print on a thermal receipt printer, or share as image, text, PDF or WhatsApp
  • The bill can be in English or Tamil
03 · LIVE RATE

Today's rate, always to hand

Gold and silver rates are shown in tables with history, refreshed every 15 minutes, and kept on the device if the network drops.

  • 24K and 22K per gram, and per 8 grams, with date-wise history
  • A scrolling rate ticker along the bottom of the home screen
  • The calculator picks the rate up automatically

App screens show sample rates and sample data.

JB One Web

An online catalogue with your shop's name on it

Not a marketplace listing. Your own address, your logo, your colours, and only your products.

04 · SHOP HOME

Customers browse. You get the enquiry.

Shoppers see your live rate strip, your categories, featured pieces and new arrivals.

  • Categories, search, filter by weight and sort
  • Product page with photos, weight, purity and a WhatsApp enquiry button
  • Opening hours, address, call and directions for your shop
  • Light and dark mode, and installable on a phone
05 · PRODUCTS

Every piece, shown properly

Product cards show the name, code, metal, weight and purity, with today's gold rate for reference.

  • Several photos per product, zoom, and weight variants
  • Optional wishlist and enquiry list, saved in the shopper's browser
  • Optional ring-size measure using the phone camera
06 · ON A PHONE

Made for the phone in the shopper's hand

Most shoppers arrive on a phone, so the catalogue is built for one, with a bottom bar for the things they use most.

  • Home, Collections, Search, Ring Size, Rate and Profile
  • Enquire on WhatsApp straight from the product page
07 · ADMIN

Manage it all from the back office

The shop owner and staff sign in with a mobile number and password.

  • Products, categories, photos (with crop, rotate and flip), and visibility switches
  • Dashboard with most-viewed and most-wishlisted products
  • Staff accounts with per-person permissions
  • Estimate calculator, and live rate and rate history

Screens are shown with sample data and a sample shop name.

Getting started

From free trial to a working counter

We set it up with you, so your team isn't left with a manual.

Questions

Good to know

Is there a free trial?

{{trial.faq}} It covers both the JB One app and the web catalogue.

Which printers does the app work with?

Thermal label and receipt printers over Bluetooth LE, USB (OTG) or Wi-Fi/LAN, using the TSPL (TSC and similar) or ESC/POS protocols. Check that your printer supports Bluetooth LE. The standard jewellery tag size is 81 mm by 12 mm, and you can add your own sizes.

Can different staff see different things?

Yes. Each person is given only the modules they need, so a billing assistant can see just the calculator and the live rate while a tagging assistant sees only label printing.

Where does the gold rate come from?

From a public gold and silver rate page, refreshed every 15 minutes, and kept on the device if the network drops.

Can customers buy online from the catalogue?

Enquiry on WhatsApp is switched on by default. Customer accounts, cart and online purchase are optional features that we can turn on for a shop.

Is our data private?

JB One shows no ads and uses no third-party analytics or trackers. The online catalogue's dashboard only counts product views and wishlist adds, without identifying visitors. Read the privacy policy.
